notes: Horne Street is marked (NOT OPEN) between Gest and Richmond; its lines (x 402/555, a lot line at 580) are drawn closed across the Gest frontage and nothing north of Gest is drawn, so Horne/Gest is recorded as a T. South of Richmond Horne is open (lines x ~400/582). West Court Street is not open west of McLean (60 ft there, block lines y 1203/1405, centre ~1304) and ends at Horne; east of McLean it is 55 ft (centre ~1276), so the McLean crossing is slightly offset. McLean Avenue is 100 ft with the C.N.O.&T.P. tracks and stone retaining walls in the roadway. Horne/? at y 3319: a street enters Horne from the west only (west block lines y 3231/3407), unlabelled; it lies on the line of West 9th, but 9th is not open between Horne and McLean (block 5 runs Richmond to 8th), so it is left as '?'. West 8th west of McLean is printed VIADUCT ... STONE APPROACH: a 110 ft right of way (block lines y 4035/4425) with a 40 ft viaduct (lines y 4140/4307) in it; Horne passes beside or under it, so the Horne/8th crossing may be grade-separated. East of McLean West 8th is 60 ft. West 9th is printed 50' near McLean and 58' near the east edge. Tucker Alley runs from McLean east off the sheet.
